resources.string: On. Use Text for predictions, Keys for immediate shortcuts. Full-screen apps start in Keys; tap Text for Zellij panes. Disable before secrets. enforce-char-based-input takes precedence.

Your keyboard sees typed input. Termux-Avic requests no personalized learning; the keyboard may ignore that request. Terminal output and history are never supplied to the keyboard.

Check suggested commands before pressing Enter. Only the current unsent token can be corrected. Letters wait for a space, punctuation, Enter, or control action. Full-screen apps start in Keys mode. Tap the Text/Keys extra key to enable predictions in Zellij panes or return to immediate keys. Ctrl+G inside a full-screen app selects Keys for the whole shortcut; tap again to return to Text. Choices belong to each session and reset when the terminal changes screens.

Use Keys in command modes, games and other apps needing immediate letters. Inside Zellij, Termux cannot detect an editor or a password prompt within a pane. Disable predictive input before passwords, tokens or private commands. The local preview can appear even when a program turns echo off.

The enforce-char-based-input property still takes precedence. Changes apply when you return to the terminal; termux-reload-settings also works.
Predictive Text mode. Tap for immediate Keys mode.
Immediate Keys mode. Tap for predictive Text mode.
Enable Predictive keyboard input in Settings → Termux-Avic → Terminal I/O first. enforce-char-based-input must be false.
